original.p: Isaiah 57:15 (WEB): For thus says the high and lofty One who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy: “I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also who is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite.

block.p: For thus says the high and lofty One who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy: I dwell in the high and holy place, with the person also who is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite.
